control.label: control
control.notes: reliable, ordered; carries all binary control messages

hover.label: hover
hover.notes: unordered, no retransmits; carries hover messages only, dropped (never sent on control) while not open

transceivers.notes: codec preference order: VP9, H265/HEVC, H264/AVC, then the rest

happy_path.action: open WebSocket (token, if any, as query parameter "token")
happy_path.notes: fail if not open within 15000 ms or if closed before open

happy_path.action: start keepAlive timer (first tick 10000 ms after mount), paused while the page is hidden
happy_path.notes: timer is armed at mount, not after the control channel opens; ticks are skipped unless the socket is open
fail if no reply within 15000 ms

happy_path.action: create peer connection with the received configuration; add recvonly audio and video transceivers; create negotiated data channels control (id 1) and hover (id 2)
attach message handler (answer, candidate, screenshot, screenshotError, later rtcConfiguration)
create offer, set local description, send
send each locally gathered ICE candidate immediately
happy_path.notes: may start before the answer arrives

happy_path.action: send zero or more (may arrive before the answer)
happy_path.notes: candidates arriving before the answer is applied are buffered, then added in arrival order right after setRemoteDescription

happy_path.action: set remote description from the answer, then flush buffered remote candidates
control data channel opens: send requestFrame 12 times, 125 ms apart (+0, +125, ... +1375 ms)
if an URL to open was supplied, send right after step 12 scheduling

refresh.action: send unsolicited credential refresh (only effective once happy_path step 6 is done: before that the next rtcConfiguration is the initial reply)
ignore if rtcConfiguration.iceServers is missing; otherwise setConfiguration({iceServers}); if that throws, stop here
suppress non-terminal connection-state dips for 15000 ms (grace window)
refresh.notes: "failed" and "closed" always pass through; a re-check at the end of the window reports a non-connected state

refresh.action: create offer with iceRestart: true, set local description
mark remote description as not set; drop buffered candidates; send
refresh.notes: candidates arriving from now on are buffered until the answer

refresh.action: set remote description; flush buffered candidates
on "connected" the grace window ends immediately

failure_triggers: WebSocket fails to open in time or closes before open
rtcConfiguration reply missing after the timeout, or a message received while awaiting it is not valid JSON
WebSocket closes while the peer connection state is not "connected"
ignored: Per connection phase. While awaiting the initial rtcConfiguration (happy_path steps 3-4): a message that is not valid JSON fails startup (a failure, see failure_triggers); valid messages of any other type are ignored.
After the general message handler is attached (happy_path step 6 onward): messages that are not valid JSON are dropped, and so are messages with an unknown type.
answer or candidate while there is no peer connection is dropped.
